desc:
🏁 FULL THROTTLE KART RACING! 🏎️💨

Street circuits,  rallycross and mountain hill climbs, all in ONE game! 🔥

🏙️ CIRCUITS – Tear through tight city streets, harbour docks and seaside tracks under the floodlights!
🌵 RALLYCROSS – Slide your cross kart through the desert, jump the ramps, smash the whoops, blast through a village and SPLASH through the water! 💦
⛰️ HILL CLIMB – Just you, the clock and the mountain. Tunnels, cliff edges and hairpins, with the helicopter filming every second! 🚁🎆

🏆 Beat the clock and win GOLD medals
⚡ Earn Bolts and unlock faster karts
🦏 Grab the beast cross karts like the RHINO
🥇 Smash your personal best again and again

🚦 3… 2… 1… GO! Can you become the fastest driver on the server?

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for new tracks and karts!
🔔 Join the group so you don't miss updates!
